title: matrix_diag_mul_line~
description: `matrix_diag_mul_line~` multiplies an n-dimensional signal vector by a dynamically changeable n×n diagonal matrix, producing an n-dimensional signal output vector. Matrix changes interpolate from the previous state over a configurable time; use `diag` to set all diagonal values, `element` to set one indexed value, `time` to change the interpolation duration, or `stop` to interrupt interpolation.
